contract: A23-69 stage 1 (switch Config.Features.StatPoints OFF): Config.Stats { MaxPoints 99, Letters A / H, Curve 1% to 20 / 0.5% to 40 / 0.25% after, AutoPattern Warrior HA / Mage HA / Archer AH }; StatPoints(L) = L - 1 (0..99, no points from rebirths); StatAlloc = the class pattern (Auto) or Order's first points (by hand, the rest free; a level reset keeps Order); StatMults = (1, 1) while off; SanitizeStats (boolean Auto, letters A-Z kept for later stats, the rest dropped, at most 99); PowerOf / CombatPower take alloc { A, H } (sqrt of attack x health with both mults); MaxCombatPower 25,488 off / 33,740 on (the even split), cached apart; Config.CombatPowerOf(player, tier?, +N?) reads Level / WeaponTier / WeaponEnhance / StatAtk / StatHp and is the one formula of JusticeService (GetCombatPower, GetPower with the rebirth bonus, the CombatPower attribute watching StatAtk / StatHp), PvPService's fallback, the Tab list column and LootService's 'Power X -> Y'; the save gains Stats = { Auto true, Order '' } as an additive field (검수 2026-10-07: Version stays 3; fillDefaults adds / repairs it, idempotent).
limitations: Stage 2 (10/16-17) adds StatService (the StatAction remote, auto placement, the blocks, StatAtk / StatHp / StatFree / AutoStat attributes), the hits (ComputeMonsterHit, ComputePvPHit inside the 0.8-1.5 caps), max HP (Config.StatMaxHealth) and the bait threshold; game dev 1 builds the [Stats] tab and switches the HUD fallback to Config.CombatPowerOf. The real DataStore load (the CR-L3 refusal of a newer record) is in tools/test_onboarding.py.
